## Feature and use

Give the exact feature string from the error or skipped-object list.
Explain what you need to read and why converted data does not meet that need.

## File and reference

Give the dataset name and index, format specification section or C source
reference, and a small synthetic fixture or public file with provenance,
licence and SHA-256 checksum. Do not attach private data.

## Expected values

Describe the HDF4 C library result and version, if available.
